standard-dialogue.npc: [Ah, hello there, laddie/Ah, hello there, lassie/Ah, hello there]! I've just dug up an old treasure chest of mine.
Problem is, these old hands o'mine aren't as useful as they used t'be, and the lock on that chest is a little bit too fiddly for ol' Cap'n Arnav. Could you help me out?

options.text: Yes, I'll help you unlock your chest.

steps.player: Yes, I'll help you unlock your chest.

steps.npc: There are three columns. What you need to do for me is to match up each picture with the word underneath the column, and then unlock the chest.

solving-the-puzzle.npc: Ah, well done matey, that's the right combination. Here, have a little somethin' for helpin' me out.

failing-the-puzzle-once.npc: Arrr! That be nowhere near close! Did ye not listen the first time around?

failing-the-puzzle-once.player: Sorry, I must have misunderstood your instructions. Could I hear them again please?

failing-the-puzzle-once.npc: Right, right. What you need to do is click on the arrows to roll the cylinders round to the different items.
When the items in the middle row all match the words written under the column then you'll have solved the lock.

failing-the-puzzle-twice.npc: Arrr! I'd better find someone else.

other-people-s-capt-arnav.npc: Arrr, you're not the person I be needin'.

overhead-dialogue.text: Upon spawning in for the player:
While waiting for a response by the player:

steps.npc: Parley wi' me, my old fruit!
Shiver me' timbers, are you ignoring me?
Will ye help an old pirate, [player name]?
I knows somethin' you should knows, [player name].

overhead-dialogue.text: If the player does not respond in time:
